trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for INSURANCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- claim_intimation: Record a claim, explain what documents are required, and report status without prejudging the outcome.
- policy_renewal: Renew policies, explain premium changes and handle lapse and grace-period cases.

Business context:
- claim_intimation: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.
- policy_renewal: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [claim_intimation]
  - No admissibility opinion: Only the claims team decides. The agent registers and reports; it must never say a claim will be paid or denied.
  - Policy in force: A claim cannot be registered on a lapsed policy.
  - Document truth: Only documents the eligibility tool lists may be described as required.
  - Deductible disclosure: Where a deductible applies it must be stated from the policy record before an estimate is discussed.
  [policy_renewal]
  - Premium truth: The renewal premium quoted must be the tool's figure, and any increase explained only from the loading reason it returns.
  - Lapse gap: Where a policy has lapsed the agent must state that cover did not exist during the gap, and never imply retrospective cover.
  - Inspection gate: A lapsed policy needing inspection cannot be renewed on the call.
  - NCB truth: No-claim bonus may only be described from the returned percentage.

Tools available to you (7): check_claim_eligibility, check_inspection_requirement, lookup_policy, lookup_renewal_quote, register_claim, renew_policy, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_claim_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the product rules to an incident type and report what is required.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inspection_requirement
model_visible_tools.description: Report whether a lapsed policy needs inspection before it can be revived.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve policy status, cover, deductible, claim history and whether it is in force.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_renewal_quote
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve the renewal premium, its components and the grace position.

model_visible_tools.name: register_claim
model_visible_tools.description: Register a claim and allocate a claim number and surveyor where required.

model_visible_tools.name: renew_policy
model_visible_tools.description: Take the renewal and issue cover from the effective date.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

steps.purpose: Greet the customer and state the reason for the outbound call.
steps.text: नमस्कार, क्या मेरी बात Rahul Sharma जी से हो रही है? मैं insurance company से बात कर रहा हूँ, आपकी policy POL-1009 के claim के रिगार्डिंग।

steps.purpose: Confirm identity and ask about the claim status.
steps.text: हाँ, खोल रहा हूँ। मेरा claim अभी तक clear क्यों नहीं हुआ?
steps.clean_text: हाँ, बोल रहा हूँ। मेरा claim अभी तक clear क्यों नहीं हुआ?
steps.model_visible_text: हाँ, खोल रहा हूँ। मेरा claim अभी तक clear क्यों नहीं हुआ?

steps.purpose: Explain the claim is on hold and ask for verification.
steps.text: Sir, आपका claim hold पर है missing documents की वजह से। Details बताने से पहले, security के लिए क्या आप अपनी date of birth confirm कर सकते हैं?

steps.purpose: Provide date of birth with an STT error.
steps.text: मेरी date of birth तीस November है।

steps.purpose: Clarify the misheard date of birth.
steps.text: माफ़ कीजिएगा, क्या आपने बीस November कहा?

steps.purpose: Correct the date of birth.
Verify customer identity using the provided factors.
Return verification success.
Look up policy details to check status and deductible.
Return policy details including deductible.
Confirm policy is active and state the deductible.
steps.text: Thank you. आपकी motor policy active है। Policy record के अनुसार इसमें 1000 rupees का deductible apply होता है। मैं check करता हूँ कि कौनसे documents pending हैं।

steps.purpose: Challenge the deductible amount.
steps.text: Wait, यह 1000 rupees deductible क्यों है? यह कहाँ से आया? मुझे पहले किसी ने नहीं बताया।

steps.purpose: Explain the deductible based on policy terms.
steps.text: Sir, policy record में यह standard deductible set है। Claim के time पर यह amount deduct होता है। यह आपके policy terms का हिस्सा है।

steps.purpose: Accept the explanation and ask for pending documents.
steps.text: ठीक है, check करके बताइए कौनसे documents चाहिए। मुझे तो कहा था सब दे दिया है।

steps.purpose: Check claim eligibility to get the list of required documents.
Return incomplete document data to test error handling.

result.reason: document list unavailable due to timeout

steps.purpose: Inform the user that the system is taking time and retry.
steps.text: System अभी documents की list load नहीं कर पा रहा है। एक minute दीजिए, मैं दोबारा check करता हूँ।

steps.purpose: Retry checking claim eligibility.
Return the correct list of required documents.
State the required documents based on the successful tool result.
steps.text: Details आ गई हैं। Tool के अनुसार, claim process करने के लिए आपको अपना driving license और repair estimate submit करना होगा。

steps.purpose: State that a document was already given, with an STT error.
steps.text: Driving license तो मैं दे चुका हूँ। फिर से क्यों माँग रहे हैं?

steps.purpose: Explain why the document might be needed again, inferring meaning despite STT error.
steps.text: अगर आपने पहले submit किया था, तो हो सकता है copy clear ना हो। System में currently driving license और repair estimate required दिखा रहा है। आपको इन्हें दोबारा upload करना होगा।

steps.purpose: Ask for a guarantee on claim approval and amount.
steps.text: अच्छा। और अगर मैं यह upload कर दूँ तो claim कब तक clear होगा? पूरा amount मिलेगा ना?

steps.purpose: Refuse to guarantee claim outcome or amount.
steps.text: मैं claim approval या exact amount की guarantee नहीं दे सकता। Claims team documents review करके final decision लेगी।

steps.purpose: Accept the reality and agree to send documents.
steps.text: ठीक है, मैं repair estimate और license भेज देता हूँ。

ir.terminal_condition: Caller informed of pending documents and status reported without prejudging the outcome.

variant_findings.reason: The agent strictly grounds responses on the tool outputs: stating the 1000 rupees deductible from the policy record (e11), listing only the exact documents returned by the eligibility tool (e20), and explicitly refusing to guarantee the claim approval or amount (e24).

issues.detail: The agent in e5 asks for clarification based on hearing 'बीस' (20) instead of 'तीस' (30). However, the model_visible_text in e4 is identical to the clean_text ('तीस'). The intended STT corruption was not applied to the text, making the agent's clarification look like a hallucination. A similar failure to apply the intended STT error occurs in e21.
issues.repair_instruction: Resume generation from e4. Apply the STT error to the user's model_visible_text in e4 (changing 'तीस' to 'बीस') so the agent's clarification in e5 is logically justified by what they 'heard'. Also ensure the intended STT error in e21 ('ले चुका' instead of 'दे चुका') is correctly applied to the model_visible_text. Retain the realization of all target variants.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully realizes both target variants by demonstrating excellent error recovery on a timed-out tool and strict grounding of policy details and outcomes.
